shared_prompt_skeleton: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single carved sign for a mobile expedition RPG, square 1:1 composition, the mark centred and filling the central 80% of the frame. Keep the exact silhouette and stroke layout of the attached reference mark. {MARK} Art style: a woodcut or die-struck stamp; confident heavy inked strokes, a few sparse cut hatches, slightly chipped worn edges, as if cut by hand into a printing block. Pure black ink on flat plain off-white paper, no paper texture. Strong silhouette that stays readable at 64 pixels. No colour, no gradient, no glow, no shadow, no background, no frame, no border, no text, typography, numbers, watermark, photorealism, glossy 3D, or decorative fantasy ornament. A single mark; no animation.

export.alpha: clamp((paper L - pixel L) / (paper L - ink L), 0, 1)
export.keying_notes: Luminance endpoints 220 (paper) and 30 (ink) clip the light paper variations to fully transparent and dark ink to solid. Antialiased edges remain fractional alpha.

review.spoilers: sectors/spire stays behind an explicit reveal; excluded from marketing and store listings
